other routes may differ."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact matching, within-problem fractions and averaging across problems are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring hidden rules from examples is explicitly linked to reasoning about unfamiliar problems."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty testing and duplicate-rule removal are described; broader representativeness is unresolved."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and corrections show checking, but comprehensive verification of reference outputs is not established."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise rule inference and combining ideas, but evidence covers only two-dimensional grids."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact output matching captures successful solutions, but gives no credit for partially correct grids and does not establish the reasoning used."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging rule is explicit, but support for its interpretation as an ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct outputs, wrong dimensions, changed squares and missing outputs; coverage is limited."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human solving studies and AI results provide context, but the human study includes puzzles beyond the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run, and no repeated-run study is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The material provides no estimates of repeated-run score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Design choices address program search and repeated solution rules without establishing that all shortcuts were investigated."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-data agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public problems remain accessible and leakage remains possible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rules distinguish permitted development training from evaluation-specific tuning and restrict feedback-driven repeated testing."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings and human difficulty matching support comparisons, but other testing routes differ and broader fairness remains unresolved."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The public licence and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and code-review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated problem and code corrections are recorded, but affected AI scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-solving claims have direct support; connections to broader intelligence extend beyond the supplied validation."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire distinguishes documented grid-solving performance from broader reasoning claims. Testing items concern whether checks occurred; the public marking tests therefore support Yes despite limited coverage.","supported_claims":["Scores describe success on unfamiliar grid problems under specified conditions because outputs are checked against complete reference grids.","The three test sets were selected for similar human difficulty using the puzzle-solving study."],"documented_problems":["The software awards fractional problem credit, while the dataset reserves 'fully solved' for all inputs being correct; these summaries can be confused.","Recorded corrections are not accompanied by recalculation of every affected AI score.","Public evaluation problems are accessible, creating a prior-exposure concern."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variation, sensitivity to presentation changes and score uncertainty are not established.","No supplied study connects scores to broader real-world abilities.","Comprehensive reference-output verification and complete marking-system validation are not established."],"reinterpretations":["A score measures exact grid-output success; it does not establish every kind of intelligence.","Human difficulty matching does not establish stability of AI scores.","A problem score of 0.5 can mean one of two inputs was solved, rather than a partly correct grid."],"closing_note":"Items about testing can blur whether any checking occurred versus whether validation was comprehensive. Comparisons also require distinguishing public evaluations from verified hidden-test conditions."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, its 1,451 pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-rule retrieval, interpretation and application are described alongside AI comparisons and broader intended uses."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied documents or images, and text or yes/no answers are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions, settings and information-supply differences are described, but historical inputs and settings are not fully linked to results."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, yes/no marking and equal weighting of six groups are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link the tasks to activities involved in understanding and applying engineering documents."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real engineering materials justify relevance, but one rulebook and uneven task groups limit coverage."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited explanation checks."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several engineering-document tasks, but the materials and task range are limited."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions earn credit, but wording, formatting and incomplete reference answers can affect scores."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but supporting evidence for the combined score or distinct group abilities is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and discussion of scoring problems document checking, though comprehensive validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI results provide context, but there is no engineer baseline and information supplies differ."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the inputs and therefore do not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors examine changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage-set variation provides some information, but uncertainty is insufficient for judging small differences in main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and familiarity are examined, but shortcut investigation is incomplete; all described scale-bar drawings comply."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks or protected evaluation data are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules for training on questions and repeatedly submitting results were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied evidence links scores to other technical documents or real engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information-supply differences are documented, but they limit direct comparisons of the AI systems themselves."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but exact historical software, settings and inputs are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The inspected sources did not establish a licence or complete responsible-reuse rules."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores are not clearly documented."},{"id":25,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The paper acknowledges restricted coverage, imperfect marking and uncertainty about performance on other technical documents."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire separates practical task relevance from evidence of broader engineering competence. Setup-change testing occurred, while identical repeated-run testing remains unclear; these require different answers.","supported_claims":["DesignQA compares performance on six types of Formula SAE document and drawing tasks under the supplied conditions.","Changes to retrieved passages and visual information were examined, supporting analysis of setup sensitivity.","The paper explicitly acknowledges uncertainty about transfer to other technical documents."],"documented_problems":["Formatting and valid rules missing from reference answers can affect credit independently of engineering understanding.","Every described scale-bar drawing complies, so always answering yes would earn its decision credit; AI use of this strategy is not demonstrated.","Systems receive different information supplies, limiting direct model comparisons.","A released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding paper question count."],"missing_information":["Comprehensive marking validation and residual reference-error rates are not established.","Identical repeated-run variation and adequate uncertainty for small model differences are not established.","Protected evaluation data, systematic exposure checks and clear training or submission rules are not established.","Complete historical reproduction records, reuse terms and score-impact change records are unavailable in the inspected material."],"reinterpretations":["Results describe an AI together with its supplied or retrieved information.","The equally weighted overall score is not established as a distinct engineering ability measure.","Practical source materials establish relevance without demonstrating transfer to other engineering work."],"closing_note":"Testing questions should distinguish changed-input experiments from identical repeated runs. Missing documentation warrants Not sure rather than No, and incomplete validation does not mean no testing occurred."}]}
